project.title: Staphylococcus aureus HG001 -  A peptide resource for the analysis of Staphylococcus aureus in host-pathogen interaction studies
project.projectDescription: Staphylococcus aureus HG001, detection of staphyococcal proteins; bacteria cultivated in TSB; samples mix of exponential, stationary (t0) and post-stationary (t4) growth
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: three approaches i) standard method without pre-fractionation; RP-LC-MS/MS ii) off-gel IEF pre-fractionation of peptides; subsequent RP-LC-MS/MS iii) SCX pre-fractionation of peptides; subsequent RP-LC-MS/MS
project.dataProcessingProtocol: Q Exactive MS/MS data; MASCOT database search; tryptic peptides; allowed missed cleavages: 2; variable modifications: deamidation/carbamidomethylation (C)/oxidation (M)/Gln -> pyroGlu (N-term Q); allowed peptide charge states: +2, +3; mass tolerance for precursor ions: 10 ppm; mass tolerance for fragment ions: 20 mmu
